name: Abstract Exchange Rates
tagline: Live and historical currency conversion with simple REST endpoints
description: Abstract Exchange Rates is a REST API for live and historical foreign-exchange rates and currency conversion. It returns JSON with base currency, target rates, timestamps, and conversion helpers. Developers authenticate with a free API key and can call live, convert, and historical endpoints for apps that need multi-currency pricing or FX display.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter (self-serve signup at Abstract). Example: ?api_key=YOUR_API_KEY

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan with limited monthly requests (confirm exact quota on Abstract pricing; historically free monthly allowance)
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans available via Abstract API dashboard for higher volume

use_cases: get live FX rate from USD to EUR
convert an amount between two currencies
fetch historical exchange rate for a past date
list multi-target rates for a base currency
